Show the real official homepage and settle on the web chat prompt input, bound to the web fact.

scenes.focusTo: API Platform and API documentation cards
scenes.purpose: Move from web chat to the developer entry: API Platform and API documentation as two plain functional cards, each filled with a short factual description so the cards are not empty shells.
Close on the confirmed call to action and site label with a full reading hold.

api-claim.text: DeepSeek links to an API platform and API documentation.

web-claim.text: DeepSeek provides a web chat entry point.

treatment.continuity: One continuous path on the screenshot-derived light-blue palette: wordmark crossfades into the real homepage, camera settles on the web chat prompt, then pushes onward to the developer entry cards, and crossfades to the endcard. Each transition overlaps the outgoing scene by its 10 transition frames. Geist Sans 600 throughout, a soft 96 bpm mallet pulse with automatic UI ticks on each land event, no voiceover. Copy is limited to exact confirmed facts and the supplied CTA, which is bound to the web and api entry-point facts it invites viewers to explore; no comparative, pricing, privacy, benchmark or availability language. The two developer cards each carry a short factual body line so they read as filled entries rather than empty outlined shells. The desktop fact is held out of this 15s cut so it is not presented as part of the web-to-API progression.
